::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [early January 1872]  
**Manuscript:** MS fragment  Historical Society of Pennsylvania: Gratz Collection: Case 11, Box 14.
:::

I am going to Lichfield from Monday to Saturday of next week - to talk and look over letters of [our noble martyr](people/person_1155.qmd) with the [Selwyns](people/person_1295.qmd). I believe I am to manage the putting his [life](cmy_books/cmybook_102.qmd) together but it will be more editing than writing. I seem to have thought of nothing but the wonderful symbolism of the work of those unconscious savages.[^1]

Your affectionate
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY refers to the murder of the Rt. Rev. John Coleridge Patteson in the Santa Cruz Islands. It was reported that Patteson’s body had received five wounds, as Christ's had.
